newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee up vs dlr in fwd, weakens in spot.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee up vs dlr in fwd, weakens in spot.

text.p: The Indian rupee was up against the forward dollar on corporate selling while it weakened in the spot market in late morning trade Tuesday, dealers said.
November-delivery dollars were quoted at a premium of 84/86 paise against Monday's close of 86/88.
"There is some selling from corporates," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Premiums have opened a bit down but should stay at these levels."
In the spot market, the rupee was down to 35.815/825 per dollar from opening quotes of 35.78/79, dealers said.
"There is some dollar buying...it appears to be the month-end demand hitting the market," said a dealer.

Dealers were uncertain whether the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) had bought dollars on Tuesday. RBI dollar purchases on Monday pushed the rupee down to an intra-day low of 35.80 before it closed at 35.78/79, off opening quotes of 35.745/755.
In latest deals, the dollar was quoted 35.81/83 rupees.
